newsitem.title: NIGER: Niger army plane crashes, 14 dead.
newsitem.headline: Niger army plane crashes, 14 dead.

text.p: A Niger army transport plane on a flight from Togo and Benin crashed as it prepared to land on Wednesday, killing all 14 people on board, the government said.
The plane, a Hercules C130, crashed near the village of Sorei about 30 km (20 miles) from the impoverished West African nation's capital Niamey, officials said.
The dead were eight soldiers and six civilians, including Niger's ambassador to Nigeria, they added.
